name: Payload Delivery
summary: Pick up a payload, deliver it to a drop zone inside an accuracy and time budget, keep it intact.
objective: Move {payload_kg} kg from {pickup} to {drop_zone} and release it so that the impact point is within {accuracy_m} m of the drop-zone centre, with an impact speed below 3 m/s.
brief: Deliver {payload_kg} kg from {pickup} to {drop_zone} before t = {deadline_s} s. Release from at least {drop_alt_m} m so the payload is not damaged; the landing point must be within {accuracy_m} m of the drop-zone centre and the impact speed below 3 m/s. One teammate may carry the payload while the other screens the corridor. Recover to {lz} afterwards.

parameters.name: pickup
parameters.desc: Pickup point with the payload attached on the ground

parameters.name: accuracy_m
parameters.desc: Circular error allowed at the drop zone

preconditions: payload secured on the pickup point
carrier UAV shows payload mass in its pre-takeoff check

actions: choose the delivery UAV and the escort role
pick a route that avoids no-fly zones
align within {accuracy_m} m of the centre
climb clear of the drop area

checkpoints.name: Payload secured
checkpoints.target: payload latched at {pickup} before t = 120 s

checkpoints.name: Drop accuracy
checkpoints.metric: distance from impact point to {drop_zone} centre

checkpoints.name: Payload integrity
checkpoints.target: impact speed < 3 m/s and damage flag = 0

checkpoints.name: Recovery
checkpoints.target: all UAVs on the ground at {lz}

failure_conditions: delivery after the task window closes
constraints: no release over a no-fly zone
escort UAV keeps >= 20 m from the carrier
grading: global checkpoint pass rate; checkpoint weights sum to 100
